## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way? Describe the situation rather than the solution.

## What you would like

How could agentsflow help? A sketch of the behavior is enough.

## Alternatives you considered

Other ways to solve it, including how you work around it today.

## Where it would live

- [ ] Web page
- [ ] Telegram bot
- [ ] Command line
- [ ] Departments mode (`serve --home`)
- [ ] Workflows or team configuration
- [ ] Documentation or installation
- [ ] Other

Reminder: whatever the web page can do, the Telegram bot should be able to do too, and the interface is in Russian. If your idea changes the interface, mention both.

## Anything else
